title: Consecutive-edition injury diff: 2026-11-15 09:00 PM -> 2026-11-16 09:30 AM
rendered_from: this file is a rendered view of the canonical diff named above, in the schema scripts/build_dashboard.py reads; the canonical file is the record and nothing here is recomputed
method: a status change is recorded only when the same (game date, matchup, team, player) prints a different Current Status in the two editions. A player who appears in one edition and not the other is listed as added/removed, not as a status change. A row whose status the PDF text layer lost in the current edition is reported under not_comparable and is never counted as a change.

not_comparable.why: PDF text layer lost the status/reason column boundary for this row: the only trailing text printed was 'Injury/Illness - Right ACL Repair / Surgery', which is a reason, not a status. Status and reason are left null and the row is flagged rather than guessed.

comparison_window.why: the report is a rolling document: it lists the next two game dates. Comparing dates only one edition covers would report every finished game as a removal.

caveats: The report is rolling: it lists the next two game dates. Rows are compared only on game dates BOTH editions print (11/16/2026); dates only one edition covers are counted separately and are not changes.
A row whose status the PDF text layer lost is reported under not_comparable, never as a status change (1 such row here).
